title: pvYieldCriteria
body:
## pvYieldCriteria

Evaluates yield criteria of selected symmetric stress tensors from their principal values σ1 ≥ σ2 ≥ σ3: Tresca as |σ3 − σ1| and von Mises as √(((σ1 − σ2)² + (σ2 − σ3)² + (σ1 − σ3)²) / 2), stored as <name> - Tresca Criterion and <name> - Von Mises Criterion in the tensor's units. The Principal Stress choice also keeps the principal value and direction arrays. Use it in structural post-processing to compare stress states with a material's yield strength. Tensor requirements match pvTensorPrincipalInvariants (6 components XX, YY, ZZ, XY, YZ, XZ, or 3 named XX, YY, XY).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The Tresca value here is the full principal-stress difference, twice the maximum shear stress; compare it with the yield strength, not the shear yield strength.
- If no criterion is selected the input passes through unchanged.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `YieldCriteria`. Identity: `filters/YieldCriteria`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
